ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 5

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 10

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

5. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 16

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

7. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 48

10. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 3

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 37

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. C — 12

2. Substitute values: x = 17 − 5
3. x = 12
Final Answer: x = 12
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 6² + 8²
3. c² = 36 + 64
4. c² = 100
5. c = 10
Final Answer: 10 cm
